description: All-in-one PS5 homebrew utility — save management, cheats, FTP, Linux loader, trophy unlocker, and file manager. Successor to Sonic Loader. WebUI on port 6969.

changelog: DPI v2 (etaHEN-compatible HTTP installer on port 12800) bundled
Switch between DPI v1 (loopback :9040) and DPI v2 (HTTP :12800) from Settings → PKG Installer → DPI version
Mutual exclusion: switching version SIGKILLs the old daemon before starting the new one
DPI version choice persists across reboots via config.ini
Accurate DPI status badge (v1/v2/not running)
i18n on all pages + full Google Translate language list

Yesterday's build caused the game library to show **Loading…** on the main page (a fresh load showed a blank grid; Refresh fixed it). Root cause: removing the cheats section FTP how-to block left a setup-time JS crash on a missing DOM element (), aborting the boot IIFE before  could run. Fixed in the latest build. Hard-refresh the page after re-sending the ELF.
Sorry for the disruption — thank you for the patience and the reports. ❤️

**Delete `/data/elf-arsenal/`** from the console (via FTP or another payload), then re-send this ELF. The fresh first-boot pass will recreate it cleanly. This wipes saved settings but fixes the corrupt config left by the early build.
Small **ⓘ** button now sits in the bottom-right corner of every game tile in the grid
Fetches a Wikipedia summary (title, description, thumbnail) for that game
Tap ⓘ to get info without launching or changing the spotlight
**Power button** added to the header
Reboot and Shutdown via the FreeBSD reboot(2) syscall — works on devkit and retail

Auto-cut for the offline pack zip. See commit 842119f. Pack contains: kstuff (3 sources), SMP 1.6test11, Linux loader v2.1, Y2JB autoloader, tile pkg, OffAct+PKGInstall, 3 cheat repos, manifest. FTP the zip to /data/elf-arsenal-offline-pack.zip then Settings -> Offline pack -> Extract now.
First Elf Arsenal release.
Rebrand from Sonic Loader
Baked-in PS5 Linux loader (v2.1) for first-boot install on FW ≤ 6.02
np-fake-signout payload (preserves username + accountId)
Background-services JSON fix (toggles hit /api/state now)
Trophy UDS daemon defaults to OFF; legacy launcher-patch defaults ON
Auto-apply patches nested into the Cheat engine settings section
nanoDNS gate on every boot-time HTTP poller
One-shot sonic-loader.elf -> elf-arsenal.elf migration for upgrading users
SDK update to v0.39 (clang 19.1.7)
